text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen had finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It's finally time, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you, Grass-chan, and become the 
best in Japan! Let's compete... for the 
top spot!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I will face you with 
everything I have.
